text.p: International Alliance Services Inc on Tuesday said it signed a definitive agreement for the sale of the environmental services business of Blue Bell, Pa., to Philip Services Corp.
International said it sold the business for cash and one-year and two-year notes approximating the book value of the division's assets, which were not disclosed.
In return, International Alliance will make available to Philip the marketing of its wide range of specialty bonding and insurance products.
The transaction is expected to close during this month.

In a press release, Edward Feighan, chief executive of International Alliance, said the company plans to redeploy the proceeds from the sale of the assets into the company's expanding business services and niche market insurance products.
